claims.claim: The admitted TASK-159 r7 Executor contract is zero-delta: this ResultPackage is bound to the admitted RUN base SHA, has no changed files or Executor evidence, and authorizes no repository mutation or implementation commit.

The native Executor performed no repository or workspace inspection and executed no commands; this package makes no claims about current collection, platform, correctness, outcomes, timing, failures, or worker preference.

TASK-159 r7 authorizes one Runtime-owned bounded same-subject experiment with one canonical collection, one serial control, and parallel profiles 2, 3, and 4 once each in authored order, without retry, fallback, adaptation, discovery, installation, preflight matrix, or result-dependent scheduling.
TASK-159 r7 is a fresh revision bound to the admitted candidate and grants no authority to alter or retry RUN-159-001 through RUN-159-006 or use their historical measurements as current expectations.

The admitted contract assigns canonical verification and EVIDENCE to Runtime, semantic verdict to Reviewer, timing interpretation and later worker or policy decisions to Human/Brain, and publication to Publisher; r7 grants no parallel default, automatic worker selector, or BP-V4 completion authority.
